يبتسم (form VIII)
# يَبْتَسِمُ (yabtasimu) /jab.ta.si.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
# يُبْتَسَمُ (yubtasamu) /jub.ta.sa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
# يَبْتَسِمَ (yabtasima) /jab.ta.si.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَسَمَ (ibtasama)
# يُب
